'''Cryseefa gas''' was an [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] [[Poison/Legends|poison]] used as a weapon by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was lethal to [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-using [[Species/Legends|species]] and corrosive.
